reviews.title: This app is bad at teaching and I didn’t even want to learn from it.
reviews.text: I just started using it but I’m going to stop. All I wanted was to tune my guitar I just got and then it put me into the lessons it doesn’t even make sure if you’ve actually done well or figured out how to do what it tells you too, it just sends you to the next lesson. I was playing with the wrong fingers but it never does anything to tell you what your supposed doing so your just wrong for a while and don’t know, and it just keeps pushing you on through the lessons.

reviews.title: An
reviews.text: I am an experience guitar player and I like that it was a tuner. I only thought it was a tuner, but no, it was a guitar learning class and it treated me like a baby and I get it. Some people need to learn how to play guitar, but I think people should go into more advanced stuff when they’re learning guitar so they can learn it quicker when I learned a guitar I jumped in, got an electric guitar and started playing songs immediately didn’t learn any chords just went along with the flow and looked at chords when I needed to and figured them out. But it’s a five out of 10.

reviews.title: Trial is gated behind a credit card
reviews.text:
I mean charge for the app, or have a free model and a pay model.

This app lets you install for free, but you can’t use it without a credit card. 

At least let me play with it for an hour to see if I want to put a credit card number down. 

I’ll just go buy a different app that doesn’t have a weird monetization strategy!

reviews.title: Shady Subscription Flow
reviews.text: It says it’s free to try but they require a subscription so it’s not. They hope you forget to cancel. Just make the thing a free trial if it’s free. Don’t be shady.

reviews.title: They double charge you, and the product doesn’t work.
reviews.text:
I didn’t even expect for the charge to go through. I thought they’d give you an option.  So I went thru with trying the app anyway. Come to find out I’ve been charged twice for a 1 month subscription. 

Instant delete. Don’t fall for this. Just use the 15$ that they would charge you and go buy a real tuner from guitar center that works.

reviews.title: Decent
reviews.text: The app is alright when it comes to tuning and learning basic notes, but it’s definitely aggravating. I don’t expect it to be perfect but when charging for such an app it should meet basic expectations. Playing the correct notes but it won’t pick up so I’m constantly replaying the same note and half of the time it just won’t work. It’s a good app if you need to tune but trying to learn is super aggravating.

reviews.title: Unclear

reviews.title: Seriously?
reviews.text: I’m sorry, with all due respect, this app is absolutely horrible. It said I played it wrong when I didn’t, and would only say I played it perfect when i purposely played it wrong. It kept saying my string was in tune, then when I like strum it says it’s SUPER out of tune, and everything was just all over the place. I just wanted to learn guitar and this is what I get. And it didn’t even let me move on with the first basic steps of the lesson! Ugh, it was so infuriating!
